CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: Real per-face subdiv scaling for non-uniform Paper Engine boxes: paper_face_grid picks the best-fit (gu,gv) grid per face by real aspect ratio, keeping the total fragment count (and wire format) unchanged. Verified with direct assertions (3:1 aspect -> 8x2, provably closer than naive 4x4) and a live interact/damage regression check on a real carved city wall. bazel build/test //... clean. Commit 27b67ba. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
